data.body: S1 amend#2: root-caused the REPO_ROOT '.tickets-tracker' leak errors (py3.12/3.13/macos cells; py3.11 passed). Culprit = my own test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py::_clean_config_env fixture delenv-ing REBAR_ROOT, which defeated conftest's autouse _default_rebar_root_to_sandbox; the CLI (main) then auto-attached the central .tickets-tracker mount into the ambient checkout (reproduced with shadow OFF -> NOT a shadow/production bug; pure test hygiene). Found via serial -x sweep after removing the pre-existing worktree symlink so the guard could fire (it named the exact test). Fix: fixture now re-anchors REBAR_ROOT to a throwaway tmp sandbox (explicit --root/repo_root still outrank it, so no assertion changes). Verified: surfaces test 5/5 with guard active, NO checkout leak; full S1 oracle 35/35; lint+typecheck clean. Amending change 1841 + re-push.
